shots.on_screen: Daylight: curly-haired woman in teal top points at dark spots on her cheek, then checks phone.
Night bedroom: she sits on bed holding the Kojic Acid Night Cream jar, talking to camera.
Jar on dark blue surface with three glowing orbs (the three actives) circling above.
Macro of rich white cream peaked in the open jar.
Fingertip scoops cream from the jar.
At a candlelit mirror she dots cream on forehead, nose and cheeks.
On the bed she spreads the cream across her cheeks with both hands.
She sleeps in bed at night, jar on the bedside table.
Before/after split: spotty skin top, clearer-looking skin bottom.
Jar in foreground on a table, woman touching her face behind it (evening).
